assets.name: miron
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: corrected production 16x16 pixel NPC sprite for Shattered Pixel Dungeon.
INPUT 1 is the ANATOMY AND PIXEL-GRID TEMPLATE: the actual original Warrior idle frame in a 16x16 transparent cell enlarged exactly 32x to 512x512. INPUT 2 is IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY: the current farmer Miron, whose overly slim body and long legs must be corrected. INPUT 3 is STYLE SUPPORT: actual six original hero classes, enlarged nearest neighbour.
Repaint INPUT 1 as Miron, a friendly stocky medieval farmer. Copy the Warrior's actual original anatomy, silhouette mass, tiny pixel grammar, compact pose, skin palette, very large broad head, thick wide SHORT torso, and extremely short stubby legs. This is a costume repaint of an original game sprite, not a new character illustration. Keep the original head / face in the upper half, head nearly as wide as shoulders. Give him a thin flat straw hat, brown hair and broad brown moustache, cream work shirt, muted olive green vest, brown trousers and boots; empty hands at his sides, remove dagger. Preserve his three-quarter view facing right.
CRITICAL PROPORTIONS on the 16x16 native grid: flat straw hat rows 0-1; broad round head / cheeks / moustache rows 2-7, about 9-10 pixels wide; WIDE thick torso and arms rows 8-11, about 10 pixels wide, no narrow waist; tiny squat legs and boots rows 12-14, no long shins; row 15 entirely transparent. Hat may span 12 pixels but must not add height. Full figure centred in columns 2-13 with maximum 12x15 bounding box and bottom at row 14. Thick compact body like the actual Warrior, not thin body from input 2.
PIXEL GRID INVARIANT: the entire square output must remain exactly the same 16x16 logical grid as INPUT 1. Each logical pixel is ONE large uniform flat colour square. Keep canvas framing and sprite's original native scale. Very few flat muted colours, soft brown outlines, simple one-pixel eyes or eye shadow. No internal fine detail in pixel squares, no antialiasing, no gradients, no glossy eyes, no black heavy contour, no realistic anatomy, no tall slender body, no long arms or legs, no oversized tall hat, no scenery, no shadow, no labels or grid. Exactly ONE sprite, no panels. GENUINE transparent background. Make this look like an additional ORIGINAL Shattered Pixel Dungeon character at 1x scale, matching the supplied actual game sprites.
